changesProposed.name: SpaceX

verified.name: SpaceX
verified.description: American spaceflight, telecommunications, and artificial intelligence company headquartered in Starbase, Texas. Operates three divisions: Space (orbital launches), Connectivity (Starlink satellite communications), and Artificial Intelligence (Grok and data centers).
verified.notes: Wikipedia source indicates SpaceX completed IPO on June 12, 2026, raising $86 billion (largest IPO in history). Elon Musk owns 42% equity with 85% voting control via super-voting stock. Company listed as public on Nasdaq (SPCX Class A). Database entry claims $1.65T valuation and 'preparing for IPO' but sources indicate IPO already completed in June 2026; valuation figure not found in provided sources.

current.name: Starcloud

verified.name: Starcloud
verified.description: A United States-based company that designs, builds, and deploys data centers in space using proprietary technology. In November 2025, Starcloud launched Starcloud-1 equipped with a Nvidia H100 GPU.
verified.notes: Company was originally founded as 'Lumen Orbit' in January 2024 in El Segundo, California and rebranded to Starcloud in March 2025 after a legal challenge from Lumen Technologies. Wikipedia source lists founding as January 2024; company website does not specify founding date or year. Series A raised on March 30, 2026, led by Benchmark and EQT Ventures.
